thread:
mia: FYI — CatalystMaps (customer) opened a support ticket: multiple 503s and timeouts hitting our hosted API since ~10:12 UTC. CS reported degraded UX and some requests returning 500 with 'upstream inference error'. They asked for an urgent ETA and repro steps.

deploy-bot: ALERT: host/upstream-infer-runner-27 crashed 8x in 6m (10:12–10:18 UTC). Restarted by k8s. Service p95 latency spiked 4x.

lina: I'm on call. Can you paste a sample request and any stack/log lines? Also which model and batch settings?

mia: Sample request from CatalystMaps (redacted): POST /v1/generate model=redwood-open-13b context_len=4096 batch_size=8 tool_calls=false.

mia: From customer's logs: 
```
2024-06-10T10:14:03Z ERROR runner: upstream worker terminated: signal SIGSEGV (code 0)
2024-06-10T10:14:03Z INFO kubelet: container restarted
2024-06-10T10:15:09Z ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB
```

raj: Seeing the same on infra metrics: GPU memory usage climbs then a segfault, then container restart. Repro on a pod shows OOM followed by SIGSEGV in attention kernel. Possibly a memory use-after-free during dynamic batching / kv-prefetch.

tom: Which runtime build are these pods on? We had a dynbatch tweak rolled out in 2024-06-08 that changed prefetch buffer handling. Build: infer-runtime@2024-06-08-rc3.

lina: Can we repro locally with the customer's payload? I'll try a scaled QPS and the same model + ctx.

raj: Quick mitigation: scaling policy bumped +2 replicas for that pool and temporarily pinned traffic away from the pool on the gateway. Applied at 10:22 UTC.

olivia: I told CatalystMaps we isolated the pool and are applying mitigations. CS asked for credits and a short summary when we know root cause.

tom: Repro steps I ran (10:35 UTC):
```
# warm KV cache then run mixed batches
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d @sample.json
done
```
Outcome: after ~120 requests with ctx ~4k and intermittent batch_size 6-8, pod OOM then segfault. Captured gdb backtrace points at attention kernel C++/CUDA.

raj: Heap snapshot from a crashed pod attached to debug workspace shows increasing pinned allocations from prefetcher — tensors not being freed until restart. Looks like a leak on fallback code path when prefetch fails.

mia: Customer also reported retries from their side. They saw '504 gateway timeout' and '500 upstream inference error' in sequence.

lina: Short-term runbook actions taken: 
- rerouted CatalystMaps traffic to backup pool (10:22 UTC)
- scaled autoscaler min to +3 for affected pool (10:23 UTC)
- rolled back infer-runtime dynbatch change on one canary node (10:36 UTC)

tom: After rollback on canary, I repro'd the same load and the canary stayed healthy for 400 requests. Non-rolled-back nodes still fail. Suggests dynbatch prefetch path is culprit.

raj: I'm creating a hotfix branch to add extra guarding and free-on-error paths for the prefetcher. Also add assert logs to catch double-free or null-deref.

olivia: CS asked for timeline. I'll offer 4 hours for a hotfix build & canary verification, and immediate $X service credit for the incident window.

simon: Billing — noted; we'll prepare credit and flag for review. Please add impacted API keys/customer IDs to the ticket.

mia: Customer asked what caused it; CS gave a short message: "We saw an upstream inference worker crash triggered by a memory handling regression in a recent runtime change. We isolated traffic and are rolling a hotfix."

tom: Debug notes for postmortem:
- suspect code: infer/runtime/prefetcher.{cpp,h}
- symptom: leak on prefetch failure + accumulation under high QPS + large ctx (>= 4k) + mixed batch sizes
- trigger: dynbatch prefetch optimistic allocation path (introduced 2024-06-08-rc3)
- reproducer: warm cache + repeated mixed-size requests with ctx 3.5k–4k at ~40 rps per pod

lina: Going to run larger canary rollouts for the rollback and verify across zones. If stable for 1h, we'll schedule full rollback.

raj: Created INC-2024-783 in tracker with tags: kernel-segfault, cuda-oom, dynbatch, rollback-hotfix. Links to crash dumps and heap snapshots in the ticket.

mia: I'll keep CatalystMaps updated and close the support ticket once rollback is fully validated.

olivia: Customer reply: "Thanks for the quick response. We'll monitor. Please keep us posted about credits and rollback." :thumbsup:

lina: Update (11:30 UTC): canary rollback stable — no crashes for 45m under repro load. Preparing full rollback.

tom: Plan: ship hotfix patch (safety free on error + logging), rollback RC3 across pool, then run extended soak. Backout plan: re-pin traffic to backup pools.

raj: ETA for full rollback and post-validation: ~2h. I'll update INC ticket with timeline and new metrics when done.

mia: Logging this thread into the incident doc and CS summary.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll draft the customer-facing summary and credits note.

simon: Billing note created and linked to INC-2024-783.

lina: Closing loop: will update thread when rollback completes.
